coverage: arc-length densification and sampling, centripetal Catmull-Rom and exact polyline
lane offset sign, signed and wrapped route distances
IDM car-following: free road, closed-form equilibrium gap, stability, authored limits
16-vehicle closed-loop platoon over 40000 frames with no pass-through
stop-line braking coming to rest short of the line
dwell/door machine: one open/close/depart per stop, doors never open on a moving vehicle
randomised 2-5 minute headway and 20-40 s dwell windows, deterministic per seed
round-robin budget coverage and catch-up integration with its clamp
3-car articulated consist posed from bogie chords through a corner
variant blocking, apportioning, density clamping, paint palette coverage
one simulated hour of bus service: strict cyclic stop order and boarding demand
PhotographerCount: the crowd hint is bracketed by floor/ceil of the exact share, never exceeds the group, is deterministic per (seed, stop, run) and is not a constant
bugsFoundAndFixed: VariantBlockStart returned 0 instead of TotalInstances for the end sentinel when VariantCount == 1, so the only block read as empty. Guard order corrected.

Re-querying NextStopAhead while braking hands back the NEXT stop once the shrinking gap crosses the skip window, and the vehicle sails through the stop it was braking for. The target must be latched at acquisition and its remainder measured with a signed distance; SignedDistanceAlong was added for this and the contract documented on NextStopAhead.
limitations: Arithmetic only. These tests establish no Unreal behaviour: no HISM instance cost, no rendering, no collision, no material or door visual, and no packaged acceptance.
The traffic model has no junctions, signals, lane changes, overtaking or cross-route interaction; a vehicle only follows the vehicle ahead of it on the same route.
The measured per-frame cost of the actor is not established here; only the boundedness of the work window is.
